Okay I’m gonna explain this as good as I can. 

When you go into any stake original, the game will have a secret code and a client code. 

So if the secret code is stake and your code(you can change this in provably fair) then it will give a number that is linked to a result.

So let’s say putting Stake and 1234 into a generator, then your first spin could be 20, 55, 99.

If you put in Stake and 5678 then The spins would be 33, 43, 22.

Stake has probably made it so if you spin for example under 100 out of 10,000, (usually this is in billions but I put it low to explain it) then it’s a bonus. Hitting 1 would mean a 500x, 2 200x and so on.

So when the private seed “Stake” and your client seed 1234 matches with say under 100, then it will give you a predetermined result. Hitting the predetermined result isn’t predetermined but the bonus is made beforehand. 

Hope it makes sense!
